segment_geo: AMER enterprise software ICPs (fictional pattern; example account Acme Energy)

baseline.primary_metric: Win rate on enterprise software ICPs using legacy pitch
baseline.primary_value: TBD - last four quarters from CRM

hypothesis: If treatment reps complete three hours of technical enablement and run the new codebase analysis playbook, win rate rises vs control and cycle length falls within six months

design.treatment: 25 randomly assigned AMER enterprise reps; new playbook + enablement
design.control: 25 randomly assigned AMER enterprise reps; legacy pitch only

staged_rollout.gate: Adoption logged on >=70% of treatment qualified opps
Treatment win rate ahead of control with agreed confidence rule
Decision log update + seller play packaged

stop_scale_rules.pause_if: Data quality on play logging fails two consecutive weeks
stop_scale_rules.iterate_if: Adoption high but no win-rate separation at 90 days
stop_scale_rules.scale_if: Treatment outperforms control on primary metric at six months

causal_clarity_notes: Control filters seasonality, competitor noise, and macro shifts shared by both groups
Remaining confounds: territory mix, AE tenure residual, SE capacity
